# Shopify

> > Shopify is a leading commerce platform enabling businesses to sell online, in-person, and everywhere in between with integrated tools for point-of-sale, payments, domains, and enterprise solutions.

Shopify provides a comprehensive ecommerce ecosystem including Shopify POS for retail, Shopify Plus for enterprise merchants, domain registration services, and developer tools like Shopify Flow. The platform is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada and powers millions of businesses worldwide with sustainability initiatives through Shopify Climate.

## Key Topics

- Shopify POS (Point of Sale)
- Shopify Plus (Enterprise)
- Domain Registration (.com, .org, .io, .net)
- SSL Certificates
- WHOIS Privacy
- Ecommerce Platform
- Inventory Management
- Shopify Payments
- Digital Products
- Shopify Flow Automation
- Shopify Partners
- Omnichannel Retail
- Shopify Climate Sustainability
- Shopify Merchant Terms of Service

- [Connect all your sporting goods sales with Shopify POS](https://www.shopify.com/pos/sporting-goods-store): Shopify POS solution for sporting goods retail stores

- [Buy .ORG Domain - Register .org Domain Name](https://www.shopify.com/domains/org): .ORG domain registration for non-profits and organizations
- [Buy .IO Domain - Register .io Domain Name](https://www.shopify.com/domains/io): .IO tech industry domain registration with SSL certificate
- [Buy .TK Domain - Register .tk Domain Name](https://www.shopify.com/domains/tk): .TK Tokelau domain registration with SSL and WHOIS privacy
